title: Progressive vs Moderate: Mehdi Debates Centrist, Contrarian Pundit Matthew Yglesias on Gaza, El-Sayed, and More
author: Mehdi Hasan
content:
**Mehdi** has never backed down from a good ol' Twitter feud, especially with
centrist, contrarian pundit **Matthew Yglesias** - the author of ['Slow
Boring'](https://www.slowboring.com/), one of the most popular political
Substack newsletters, and one of the most-read writers
[inside](https://www.washingtonpost.com/lifestyle/2023/01/11/matt-yglesias-
slow-boring-in-bidens-washington/) of the Biden transition team.

In this 'Mehdi Unfiltered' segment, the two finally take each other on, **in-
person,** for the very first time.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

As per usual, Mehdi brings the receipts, with Yglesias even telling Mehdi at
one point, **" you're a tough interviewer."**

In a high-stakes showdown, Yglesias meets the hard questions head-on and
delivers sharp answers. The IRL clash takes place in four parts:

  * **PART 1:** Mehdi presses Yglesias on why he thought pro-Israel Democrat Haley Stevens, who lost the Michigan Senate primary despite [massive](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/08/04/us/politics/michigan-democratic-senate-primary-aipac.html) outside spending on her race, would have been a better candidate against Republican Mike Rogers than progressive Abdul El-Sayed. **" I don't think that skill at winning primaries is correlated with skill of winning general elections," **Yglesias says.

  * **PART 2:** The two also get into a heated back-and-forth over 'Abolish ICE' and Yglesias's [criticism](https://www.rollingstone.com/politics/politics-features/democrats-centrist-welcomefest-everything-wrong-1235356464/) of Democrats [visiting](https://www.npr.org/2025/04/17/nx-s1-5367666/abrego-garcia-van-hollen-el-salvador) a wrongly deported man in El Salvador last year. Mehdi asks Yglesias directly if he thinks Democrats **" should not speak out against the president sending migrants who have committed no crimes to be tortured in a foreign gulag?" **Yglesias replies: **" Yeah…You got to win first."**

  * **PART 3:** Mehdi confronts Yglesias over his comments on Israel and Gaza - including his [claim](https://x.com/mattyglesias/status/2070199480498954540) that there "wasn't any genocide" in Gaza and that Israel's war [was](https://www.slowboring.com/p/israels-two-wars) "just." Mehdi asks why Yglesias has [said](https://x.com/mattyglesias/status/1724634353517330893?s=46) Sudan is a genocide but Gaza is not, to which Yglesias responds, **" Wait, did I call Sudan a genocide?**_**"**_

  * **PART 4:** The two debate whether Yglesias's political advice to Democrats amounts to pure poll-driven pragmatism, with Mehdi wondering whether Yglesias would have told JFK and LBJ to slow down on civil rights, and saying to him: "**You just want to follow the polls … Don't you want to try and persuade people?"**
